security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-src 'none'; form-action 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Run iLEAPP and aLEAPP and take iOS backups, with cases and audit records
bundle.longDescription: suiteDFIR runs the pinned, verified iLEAPP and aLEAPP mobile-forensics parsers and takes iOS backups over USB, organizes the results in case folders, and keeps an audit record with hashes for every run and acquisition.
